test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.

“If I were you, I would not trust such vague promises,” said the mentor.

options.text: The mentor said that if he were me, he wouldn't trust such vague promises.
The mentor said if he had been me, he wouldn't trust vague promises.
The mentor said that if he were me, he would not trust such vague promises.
The mentor said he would not trust such vague promises if he were me.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
